kjv: Almost thou (Paul) persuadest me (Agrippa) to be a Christian
mine: In a short time would you (Paul) persuade me (Agrippa) to become a Christian?
note: en oligo means "in a short time" or "with little effort" (cf. Paul's reply, "whether short or long"), and SBLGNT reads "poiesai" (to make), not TR "genesthai"; Agrippa's words are a dry deflection. The KJV turns them into a near-conversion and the source of a famous hymn and sermon theme.
